description: Detect AI-writing tells in text. POST prose and get a 0-1 ai_ness score + band (low/medium/high) + the EXACT patterns that fired (AI vocabulary, significance inflation, promotional language, filler phrases, negative parallelism, rule-of-three, em-dash overuse) with sample spans. Explainable, not an opaque classifier - every point is a named, located pattern. Deterministic, no LLM. The rewrite is a separate step.

text.description: The prose to score (up to 100k chars).

name: humanizer_score
